mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TIMESTAMP ( TIMER_ID , REMAINING_TIME , CURRENT_TIME , CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{timerId}, #{remainingTime}, #{currentTime}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT TS.ID , TS.TIMER_ID , TS.REMAINING_TIME , TS.CURRENT_TIME , TS.CREATED_AT FROM TIMESTAMP TS WHERE TS.TIMER_ID = #{timerId} ORDER BY TS.CURRENT_TIME ASC
